title: How is Adolf Hitler connected to Sonic?
description:
The Beetle's designer, the Mercedes racing team, two racing legends, a seven-time champion, a talk-show host and Jim Carrey connect Adolf Hitler to Sonic the Hedgehog.

Adolf Hitler → Ferdinand Porsche → Alfred Neubauer → Juan Manuel Fangio → Stirling Moss → Lewis Hamilton → Jimmy Kimmel → Jim Carrey → Sonic the Hedgehog

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Adolf Hitler → Ferdinand Porsche: Ferdinand Porsche showed Hitler a model of his new people's car, the Volkswagen Beetle.
   Photo by Heinrich Hoffmann, Public domain (PD-anon-70-EU): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Hitler_with_Beetle.webp
2. Ferdinand Porsche → Alfred Neubauer: In 1924, Porsche took a race car to Sicily with Alfred Neubauer, the father of pit signals.
   Photo, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Auto-ontwerper_Ferdinand_Porsche_(rechts)_en_Alfred_Neubauer_met_een_racewagen,race-auto_op,_SFA007000597.jpg
3. Alfred Neubauer → Fangio: By 1955, Neubauer ran the Mercedes team, and his star driver was Fangio.
   Photo by Joop van Bilsen for Anefo, CC0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Training_voor_Grote_Prijs_van_Nederland_op_Zandvoort,_leider_van_de_Mercedesploe,_Bestanddeelnr_907-1856.jpg
4. Fangio → Stirling Moss: Two days later, Fangio won that race, and teammate Stirling Moss congratulated him.
   Photo by Harry Pot for Anefo, CC0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Grote_Prijs_van_Nederland_Zandvoort._De_winnaar_J._M._Fangio_(links)_wordt_gefel,_Bestanddeelnr_907-1900.jpg
5. Stirling Moss → Lewis Hamilton: Decades later, Moss posed with a teenage Lewis Hamilton, a future seven-time champion.
   Photo by Fluffyghost, CC BY-SA 4.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bob_Ives,_Lewis_Hamilton._Joe_Ives,_Stirling_Moss.jpg
6. Lewis Hamilton → Jimmy Kimmel: In 2022, Sir Lewis told Jimmy Kimmel about being knighted.
   Photo by Jimmy Kimmel Live / ABC (YouTube), Fair use (commentary): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LSuuxVyyd2I
7. Jimmy Kimmel → Jim Carrey: In 2017, a heavily bearded Jim Carrey sat down with Kimmel.
   Photo by Jimmy Kimmel Live / ABC (YouTube), Fair use (commentary): https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LQMvZ5nvjc8
8. Jim Carrey → Sonic: Jim Carrey posed with Sonic at the 2020 premiere.
   Photo by Dulce Osuna, CC BY 3.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:JimCarreySonicMoviePremiere2020.jpg

Research notes: Commons only had a tiny copy of the famous Beetle-model photo, so a larger scan of the same Hoffmann photo came from Santa Clara University's exhibit; from there, motor racing leads to Lewis Hamilton, and Sonic comes in through a real 2020 premiere photo of the costumed Sonic with Jim Carrey.

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#adolfhitler #sonicthehedgehog #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
first_comment:
Fun fact from the research: Alfred Neubauer, pictured with Porsche in 1924, is credited with inventing pit signals: he was the first team boss to signal his drivers with flags and boards from the pit wall.

Who should Hitler connect to next? Name anyone (a character works too) and I'll find the photos.
